lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sc₄Mo₄O₁₂ (ScMoO₃) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 194), with 20 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for both Mo and Sc centers, each with six O neighbors, while O centers adopt square-pyramidal environments with two Mo and three Sc neighbors. Polyhedron-sharing analysis shows corner-sharing between Mo and Sc octahedra, and both corner- and edge-sharing among O square-pyramidal polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
